definitions.durable_receipt: Native driver writes an exact operation-bound result durably before acknowledging completion.
definitions.uncertain_operation: Dispatch intent exists without a committed terminal receipt; never automatically replay.
definitions.lost_context: A previously staged native context absent from the restarted driver; stop and hand over after outstanding operations are reconciled.

product_prototype: Resume the existing ARE supervisor through native-driver restart using persisted receipts and conservative uncertain-outcome handling.
business_prototype: Prove native recovery boundaries without model spend.

requirements: Exact task, context and operation binding
Persistent dispatch intent before native execution
Recycle lost contexts only after reconciliation

acceptance: Abrupt native exit after open receipt recovers
Abrupt native exit after completion receipt recovers without duplicate provider sends
Abrupt native exit after source seal recovers
Exit before dispatch without receipt stops as uncertain
Exit after provider response without completion receipt stops as uncertain
Corruption and binding drift fail closed
open_questions: How will production app-server own these receipts?
How can external tools and provider outcomes be reconciled using their own durable evidence?
Which live meter proves request bounds?
